item.title: Getting started with RAG in ASP.NET Core
item.description: AI hype is everywhere, but where do you start with .NET? In this beginner-friendly post, we build a simple RAG pipeline in an ASP.NET Core Web API using keyword matching instead of embeddings, covering retrieve, augment, and generate end to end, with vector embeddings saved for a later post. Link to article: https://blog.elmah.io/getting-started-with-rag-in-asp-net-core/
